0022600132.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-2, 2nd in the Southeast and 1 game back, 7th in the East) host the Miami Heat (0-4, 5th in the Southeast and 3 games back, 15th in the East) in the fifth game of the Hawks' season, with Miami on a four-game losing streak. Atlanta is 0-1 at home and 2-1 on the road, while Miami is 0-3 at home, and the Hawks are on a two-game losing streak. Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out for Atlanta, and Simone Fontecchio (illness) is out for Miami, and in the 2025-26 season series the Hawks lost 1-3, including a 143-117 defeat in Miami in their last meeting.
